text:
[Council File 26-1420]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a proposed deaccession policy for the disposition of artwork and objects in the City Art Collection that mirrors other municipalities and museums, or other industry best practices.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez – Hutt):
INSTRUCT the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), in coordination with the Department of Cultural Affairs and other necessary departments, to report to Council on a proposed deaccession policy that mirrors what other municipalities and museums have created, or include other industry best practices.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: A motion calling for a deaccession policy that sets out how the city can dispose of artwork and objects in its City Art Collection, modeled on other municipalities, museums and industry best practices.
